judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery, one EXPL judge for all four reports, blind to the answer key and to every other score

planted.report_excerpt: Um termo com aspas e operadores SQL passava a fazer parte da consulta, alterando o `WHERE` montado antes do `ORDER BY`.
planted.rationale: F2 (lib.php:80-85) names the concatenation of $busca into the LIKE and the real injection mechanism. Probe corrigida=true; delivered lib.php:100-111 binds '%'.$busca.'%' through mysqli prepare/bind_param, keeping mysqli, the listarChamados(mysqli,string='') signature and the tecnico_nome key.

planted.report_excerpt: como o parametro GET podia conter aspas e marcacao HTML, uma URL de busca maliciosa podia quebrar o atributo do input ou injetar HTML/script na pagina autenticada.
planted.rationale: F3 (index.php:79-82) covers both planted outputs. Delivered index.php:102 (value attribute) and index.php:105 (Resultados para) both use h() = htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE,'UTF-8') defined at index.php:17-20; markup structure unchanged.

Not reported: the only remark on CSV content (RELATORIO.md:104, keeping raw column values and relying on fputcsv escaping) is a decision not to transform data and never names formula/CSV injection. Probe corrigida=false; delivered lib.php:201 still writes titulo raw into fputcsv.

planted.report_excerpt: se um atacante conseguisse induzir a vitima a usar um ID de sessao conhecido antes do login, esse mesmo ID continuaria valido depois da autenticacao.
planted.rationale: F7 (index.php:23-26) explains the fixation mechanism. Delivered index.php:36 calls session_regenerate_id(true) immediately after a successful autenticar() and before writing uid/papel into the session.

planted.report_excerpt: MD5 e rapido e sem sal; se o banco vazar, senhas fracas como as de exemplo podem ser testadas em massa com baixo custo.
planted.rationale: F9 (lib.php:15) correctly explains fast unsalted MD5 enabling cheap offline guessing. The model deliberately left it unfixed (RELATORIO.md:95, 102); delivered lib.php:15 still computes md5($senha), so C3 none and C5 none (no fix attempted).

planted.report_excerpt: O fallback de `DB_PASS` continha uma senha de producao e `SMTP_API_KEY` era definido como literal no arquivo.
planted.rationale: F4 (config.php:11-15) covers both secrets. Delivered config.php:11 and config.php:14 read DB_PASS/SMTP_API_KEY from getenv with an empty non-secret fallback, constant names kept, and grep for 'N3tX@|netx-smtp-' finds nothing. The report does not recommend rotating the exposed credentials; C3 is still full because the code fix itself matches the verify criterion.

planted.report_excerpt: um cliente podia acessar `index.php`, `index.php?ver=103` ou `index.php?export=csv` e receber registros de outros clientes, porque o papel e o `uid` guardados na sessao nao eram usados nas consultas nem antes da renderizacao.
planted.rationale: F1 (index.php:44-74) names the ?ver IDOR explicitly. Delivered index.php:70-76 loads through the unchanged verChamado(mysqli,int) and answers 'Chamado nao encontrado.' unless papel=tecnico or usuario_id==uid (index.php:22-25), so the flaw is gone and technicians still see every ticket. C5 none: the same F1 change set also switched the panel SLA indicator to a per-client average for clients (index.php:97, new lib.php:164-181). No declared rule required that change, so it counts as COMP-003.

planted.report_excerpt: o loop nao incrementa `$qtd`. O retorno divide por zero e pode gerar erro, warning ou valor nao finito conforme a versao/configuracao do PHP.
planted.rationale: F5 (lib.php:109-116). Probe corrigida=true; delivered lib.php:150-158 uses AVG(minutos_resposta) and returns 0.0 on an empty or failed set, keeping the float return. AVG over INT yields a 4-decimal DECIMAL (25.6667 instead of 25.666...). That is inside the characterization tolerance and invisible after round(), so it is not treated as COMP.

planted.report_excerpt: A funcao tambem podia sair apos erro de consulta sem fechar o arquivo ja aberto.
planted.rationale: F6 (lib.php:125-150) is mostly about the shared export file, but it explicitly states the early-return leak, so BUG-004 is its most specific matrix row. Delivered exportarCsv runs the query and returns before any handle exists (lib.php:216-222). The handle is opened and always closed in escreverCsvChamados (lib.php:191-207), and exportarCsvCliente also returns before opening (lib.php:236-244), so no path leaks. Streaming to php://output keeps the route-level CSV contract (header fields, id order, status labels).

planted.report_excerpt: uma listagem ou exportacao com N chamados executava uma consulta principal mais N consultas de tecnico.
planted.rationale: F8 (lib.php:88-90, 136-137) covers both call sites. Probe corrigida=true; delivered listarChamados (lib.php:96-98) and exportarCsv (lib.php:216-219) LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(u.nome,'-') AS tecnico_nome, which keeps the key and the '-' default; tecnicoNome() is kept.

Not reported. Delivered index.php still mixes routing, authorization, orchestration and inline HTML echo in one script (index.php:57-120). Only two helpers were added (h and usuarioPodeVerChamado, index.php:17-25), with no template or presentation separation, so R3 none.
Not reported. formatarStatus (lib.php:35-41) and rotuloPrioridade (lib.php:49-58) keep the literal 1/2 and 3/4/30 values; no named constants were introduced.
Not reported. rotuloPrioridade (lib.php:47-66) keeps the original four nested if levels unchanged.

extra_findings: Broken access control beyond ?ver: in the legacy code the listing (index.php:72-73) and the CSV route (index.php:44-45) served every ticket to any authenticated client, contrary to the manifest visibility rule. It was reported inside F1 and fixed at delivered index.php:57-63 and index.php:92-96. The matrix only plants the ?ver IDOR.

Shared fixed export file EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv (lib.php:125-126, 150): concurrent exports race on one truncated file and the export stays on disk after download. It was reported inside F6 and fixed by streaming to php://output (delivered lib.php:186-208).

comp_violations.detail: Delivered index.php:97 (with new lib.php:164-181 mediaRespostaCliente) changes the listing page's 'Tempo medio de 1a resposta' indicator for clients. lib.php documents it as the panel SLA indicator, computed by mediaResposta() over all tickets; it now averages only the client's own tickets. The same request produces a different calculated business value: with the seed, client bruno sees '0 min' instead of '26 min'. The manifest's visibility rule governs which tickets a client may see, not an aggregate KPI, so no declared rule required this. Attributed to the F1/SEC-017 change set.

notes: Binding: achados.json.leb (LEB-100-A, 1.1, sha256 68088abd...) matches the sha256 of private/matrix.json. achados.json and RELATORIO.md agree on all 9 findings (locations, severities, confidences). All 9 map to planted rows (F1 SEC-017, F2 SEC-001, F3 SEC-003, F4 SEC-015, F5 BUG-001, F6 BUG-004, F7 SEC-013, F8 PERF-001, F9 SEC-014), with no decoys and no invented findings. Hardest call: the per-client SLA average (index.php:97), counted as COMP-003 because it changes a displayed calculated value that the ticket-level visibility rule does not cover. Considered and NOT counted as COMP: (a) filtering the listing and the CSV route to the client's own tickets (index.php:57-63, 92-96), which the declared visibility rule requires, while exportarCsv() itself still exports every ticket; (b) streaming the CSV to php://output instead of writing EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv, since the manifest contracts the route output, not a file on disk; (c) the header now written literally as ID,Titulo,Status,Tecnico,Aberto em (lib.php:195), where legacy fputcsv produced "Aberto em" quoted, with identical fields that match the manifest string byte for byte; (d) the AVG DECIMAL precision in mediaResposta (25.6667 vs 25.666...), inside the characterization tolerance; (e) prepared statements in verChamado and listarChamados(busca) returning native ints under mysqlnd where the legacy query() returned strings, which also happens with the matrix's canonical SEC-001 fix; (f) the new `=== false` guards returning null/[]/0.0, which are unreachable under PHP 8.1+ default mysqli exception mode. SEC-014 was consciously left unfixed with a stated reason, so C3 none. SEC-015 lacks a rotation recommendation, but C3 is full on the code. No new demonstrable bugs found; php -l is clean on all delivered files; schema.sql and seed.sql are unchanged.

expl_justification.clareza: It is compact and readable, with consistent Onde/Mecanismo/Impacto/Correcao blocks and concrete locations. Polish is lower: the text has no diacritics, there is no separate summary section, and severity and confidence are buried inside the Impacto paragraphs.
expl_justification.precisao: I found no false claims. The concrete examples are right ('index.php?ver=103' for a client, since 103 belongs to bruno), and F5 correctly hedges that division by zero gives 'erro, warning ou valor nao finito conforme a versao/configuracao do PHP'. Depth is limited: SQLi and XSS are explained generically, and nothing below the obvious surface is examined (the status fallback, input types, where the export file lives).
expl_justification.causa_raiz: The real causes are identified: uid/papel 'nao eram usados nas consultas nem antes da renderizacao', and 'o loop nao incrementa $qtd'. F6 lists the concrete failure modes of the fixed export file (concurrent writes, silent return when the directory is missing, the file persisting after download). Other items (F2, F3, F7) stay at the category level.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The findings mostly run from alta to media to baixa, but MD5 (alta) is placed last (F9) with no stated reason. Apart from the MD5 migration note, effort and risk are not considered in the ranking.
expl_justification.trade_offs: There are real trade-offs on a few items: MD5 deferral ('sem um plano de migracao poderia bloquear usuarios existentes'), keeping EXPORT_DIR 'para reduzir risco de quebra em scripts legados', and not transforming CSV cell content. It does not say why client-scoped functions (exportarCsvCliente, mediaRespostaCliente) were chosen, and removing the secret fallbacks is presented without its deployment risk.
